Author: goodmasta
Name: Collection Viewer
Punchline: View FFXIV Collect collections (mounts, minions, orchestrions, etc.) in-game.
Description: Shows a character's collection (yours, or any player via right-click) using FFXIV Collect data: mounts, minions, orchestrions, emotes, hairstyles, bardings. Per-category progress, icons, search. UI available in English and Russian. Not affiliated with FFXIV Collect.
